description: Self starter clicking or kick start not firing engine
reasoning: Check battery voltage, ignition spark, and blade fuse integrity

description: Vehicle lacks pulling power on slopes or throttle hesitation
reasoning: Inspect air filter restriction, spark plug health, CVT belt slippage, and clutch plate wear

description: Fuel consumption is significantly higher than usual
reasoning: Air filter clogging, rich fuel mixture, incorrect spark gap, and low tyre pressure cause high consumption

description: Brakes feel spongy weak or make screeching noise
reasoning: Worn out friction material, glazed drums, or low hydraulic fluid compromise safety

description: Clattering or loose chain sound from rear wheel
reasoning: Excessive chain slack, uneven elongation, or worn sprocket teeth

description: Tappet ticking metallic knocking or rough engine vibration
reasoning: Low or degraded oil causes excessive friction and valve train noise

description: Self starter not engaging horn sounds weak or battery dead
reasoning: Battery charge depletion, dead cell, or blown primary fuse

description: Frequent air drop wobbling or visible tyre wear
reasoning: Tread depth below safety limit, valve pin leak, or puncture

description: Headlamp or indicator not turning on or flickering
reasoning: Bulb filament burned out or loose holder grounding

description: Front fork oil leaking or hard thud on speed bumps
reasoning: Damaged fork dust/oil seals causing hydraulic damping loss

description: Grinding or hum sound from wheels during rotation
reasoning: Dried bearing grease or pitted ball races require replacement

description: Regular periodic servicing routine maintenance and checkup
reasoning: Routine preventive replacement of engine oil and consumable filters

description: Unspecified mechanical or electrical issue needing mechanic inspection
reasoning: Comprehensive multi-point inspection to pinpoint exact fault
